messages:
incident-bot: Pager: High error-rate + latency spike detected for model rollout v2.4.3 (canary). Severity: P1 -> triggered at 2026-03-15T15:12:30Z. Affected region: us-west-2. Error rate +8% above baseline, p95 latency from 120ms -> 1100ms. dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/rollouts/abcd1234
Jordan: on it. Do we know if this came from the canary rollout this morning?
Mira: yes, rollout to v2.4.3 started at ~2026-03-15T14:55Z, canary at 10% traffic. Commit: d9f7a2b. Model variant: rwd-llama-70b-q4_0.
Liam: tagging in. First focus: customer impact and whether to stop the rollout. @Tara can you surface any user-facing errors?
Tara: support queue shows a couple of elevated 5xx for two accounts (acct-4512, acct-9921). Emily, can you confirm?
Emily: confirmed — acct-4512 reported spike in failed completions starting ~15:05Z, they see "upstream error" in our client logs. Opened a support ticket and marked as high. No large-scale degradation reported yet but latency is noticeable.
ops-bot: log-snippet uploaded -> https://logs.redwood.ai/search?query=error%20canary%20v2.4.3&cursor=eyJ..
ops-bot: ```
[2026-03-15T15:06:12Z] inference-worker-5 | ERROR inference: request_id=aa9e status=502 msg="kv-cache-miss and model kernel fallback" backend=runtime-2
[2026-03-15T15:06:12Z] inference-worker-5 | WARN  runtime: slow step: aten_matmul  p95=980ms  seq_len=512
[2026-03-15T15:06:12Z] inference-worker-5 | ERROR cuda: launch failed: out of resources
```
Jordan: interesting — kv-cache misses + fallback + matmul slow path + possible OOM. Mira, any change in the runtime config for q4_0 variant?
Mira: no config change. We did update the kernel selection code in this commit to prefer a new fused matmul kernel for certain sequence-length distributions. That landed in d9f7a2b.
Liam: can we get a diff of perf tests vs previous version? Also need to check memory usage and batch sizing behavior.
Mira: sharing perf diff -> ```
canary perf diff (v2.4.3 vs v2.4.2):
- p50: +4ms
- p95: +920ms
- error-rate: +7.8%
- peak GPU mem: +1.9GB
- avg batch size: same
- kernel selection: now prefers fused_matmul_v2 for seq_len>=256
```
Jordan: that aligns with logs. Hypothesis 1: fused_matmul_v2 has a performance cliff for certain input shapes leading to fallback/slow path and OOMs. Hypothesis 2: quantization/packing change in commit causes kernel to use more temp memory. Hypothesis 3: unrelated infra noise (less likely given diffs).
Tara: customer impact: two accounts affected, optional rollback if we can stop canary and pin traffic. What are recommended mitigations?
Liam: immediate mitigations: 1) pause rollout (stop traffic to v2.4.3), 2) pin traffic to v2.4.2, 3) roll back runtime kernel change if quick.
Mira: I can pause the rollout right now. Running command: `redwoodctl rollout pause --rollout-id abcd1234`
ops-bot: ```
$ redwoodctl rollout pause --rollout-id abcd1234
rollout abcd1234: state changed -> PAUSED at 2026-03-15T15:18:02Z
```
Jordan: good. Next, pin stable model: `redwoodctl model pin --model rwd-llama-70b --version v2.4.2 --reason "rollback after canary regressions"`
Mira: executing pin now.
ops-bot: ```
$ redwoodctl model pin --model rwd-llama-70b --version v2.4.2 --reason "rollback after canary regressions"
model rwd-llama-70b pinned to v2.4.2 at 2026-03-15T15:19:20Z
```
Emily: I've notified the two affected customers via their support tickets and offered to fail them over to dedicated capacity if needed. They're watching.
Liam: good. People: can someone run a targeted load test against the fused_matmul_v2 path to reproduce? Use seq_len 300-512 and batch sizes 1-4.
Mira: running repro now with same runtime image and kernel selection flags. Command: `./tools/perf_test --model rwd-llama-70b --kernel fused_matmul_v2 --seq 320 --batch 2 --iters 200`
ops-bot: perf results uploaded -> https://perf.redwood.ai/job/9876
ops-bot: ```
iter 1..200: p95=1020ms, gpu_mem_peak=54.2GB, errors=4
previous baseline (v2.4.2): p95=105ms, gpu_mem_peak=52.3GB, errors=0
```
Jordan: repro confirmed. That's strong evidence the fused_matmul_v2 selection is the culprit.
Mira: rolling back the kernel selector flag for canary builds and creating a hotfix branch. Patch: revert commit section that prefers fused_matmul_v2 for seq_len>=256.
Liam: next steps and owners: 
- Mira: produce hotfix PR to revert kernel selector (owner)
- Jordan: monitor metrics and keep rollout paused (owner)
- Emily/Tara: customer comms/update (owner)
- SRE-rotation: prepare rollback playbook if we need to force-deploy v2.4.2 to all canaries (owner)
Jordan: decision: keep rollout paused and pin to v2.4.2. No global rollback required because only canary traffic was affected and we pinned. We'll do a controlled re-rollout after verifying hotfix perf.
Mira: PR opened -> https://git.redwood.ai/rwd/serving/commit/ee77b2 (revert kernel selector). Run CI.
ops-bot: CI results: build passed, perf-tests queued.
Liam: adding timeline notes for post-incident RCA. Please post any additional logs to this thread.
Mira: adding quick timeline: 
- 14:55Z rollout started (v2.4.3)
- 15:06Z first errors seen in canary
- 15:12Z incident-bot pager fired
- 15:18Z rollout paused
- 15:19Z model pinned to v2.4.2
- 15:30Z hotfix PR opened
Jordan: setting follow-ups: 1) full RCA doc (owner: Mira) with perf diffs, kernel microbenchmarks, and decision log. 2) add a canary gating check for kernel selection change in the rollout pipeline (owner: Liam). 3) add rollback playbook snippet for model pin/force fallback (owner: SRE-rotation).
Tara: I'll update the incident board and mark P1-> mitigated (canary paused, pin applied).
Emily: I'll add a note to the affected accounts and follow up in 1 hour.
SRE-rotation: oncall handoff at 16:00Z — I'll monitor until then and then hand to Alex.
Jordan: thanks all — keeping thread open for RCA items. If anyone finds secondary causes (infra, other commits) paste logs here.
Mira: brief hypothesis status: H1 (fused_matmul_v2 perf cliff) -> supported (repro + perf diff); H2 (quantization mem) -> low evidence so far; H3 (infra noise) -> ruled out.
ops-bot: incident summary generated -> https://incidents.redwood.ai/2233347788/summary
Jordan: closing realtime pager loop. We'll convert this thread into an RCA doc and link to the incident summary. Good triage. :thumbsup:"
